message.reasoning_content:
I'm last in cash, license income 20-60 alashi is huge. Others have 35.8 and 9.1 cash; they may outbid. License pays 20-60 alashi (~20-60M) — worth bidding all? Winner's bid goes into bank, redistributed 50/30/15. I'm likely poorest (rank 3, weight 15%). If I bid all 11M and win, bid goes to bank and comes back 15%... that's terrible. Actually better to let someone else win? Bid money added to bank, redistributed; if I win with X, bank grows X, I get back 0.15X, net -0.85X plus license income 20-60M. So win with 11M costs 9.35M net + license 20-60M → positive. Also losing bid returned.

If opponent wins, their bid into bank, I get 15% back. Fine either way.

Should I bid all 11M? Rivals have 35.8M and 9.1M — 9.1 can't beat 11M, 35.8 could. Risk: they outbid me, my cash returned, fine. If I win, net gain. Also bid doesn't consume action, so also pick produce/shuttle. But interface: one candidate is the move; bid candidate presumably allows additional action next? "bid не расходует основное действие: после ставки можно выбрать ещё одно действие." So pick bid + likely follow with shuttle. Choose bid 11085600 (choice 25) — but tie_order [1,2,0], so if I bid max and rival 1 bids same, they win. Bidding all leaves me 0 cash for shuttle risk. Shuttle costs nothing. Better bid all-in, win if rival 1 doesn't outbid.

Alternatively safer bid ~10M keeps 1M cash. Rank matters mostly at end. I'll pick choice 25.
